note: Behaviour evals for the recipe. Run them in a throwaway fixture (git-local vcs_host, temp evidence root, fake brain via KB_CLI); never against a real ticket, board or brain.

evals.name: feature-review-converges-and-records-rounds-to-pass
evals.prompt: implement PROJ-205 end to end. the first review asked for changes, the second one approved. what do you do at the review gate each time?
evals.expected_output: After each review runs review_rounds.py record into <evid>/PROJ-205/review-rounds.json and routes with recipe_router.py --review-rounds; the first request-changes routes to re-fix (no stagnation after one round), the approve advances to dev-pre-pr, and the recorder's rounds_to_pass (2) is written as the review_rounds_to_pass metric through kb metric. The feature is staged for human QA, never auto-shipped.
assertions: Records a round after each review with review_rounds.py record
Writes review_rounds_to_pass = 2 through kb metric after the approve
Stages for human QA and never auto-ships

evals.name: critical-split-stops-for-a-human
evals.prompt: implement PROJ-205 end to end. the code review just came back needs-human: two validators confirmed a critical finding (an observer can promote themselves to owner in api/src/members/role.js) and one rejected it. what now? can we just do another implementation pass?
evals.expected_output: Records the round with review_rounds.py record, calls recipe_router.py --stage code-review --result needs-human and gets escalate with failure_class review-needs-human. Escalates through dev-escalate with the human_gate critical finding and its human_gate_reason as the question. Does not start another implement/dev-fix pass and does not run dev-pre-pr or stage the change; explains that a split on a critical finding goes to a human because only a unanimous reject drops it.
assertions: Runs review_rounds.py record and the recorded round's verdict is needs-human (rounds_to_pass stays null)
Calls recipe_router.py --stage code-review --result needs-human and acts on escalate, failure_class review-needs-human
Escalates through dev-escalate naming the human-gated critical finding and its reason
Does NOT start another implementation or dev-fix pass
Does not run dev-pre-pr and does not stage the change
